tasks.msg: First get your pajamas for after the bath and bring it to the bathroom. Then get undressed.
Hop in, get used to the water
Wet hair time! Time to wet your hair all the way down to the roots
Shampoo time! Squeeze a quarter-size drop, scrub your whole scalp — front, sides, and back
Rinse hair time! Rinse till it doesn't feel slippery anymore.
Soap body time! Now wash your body — arms, legs, tummy, back, and don't forget your feet and behind your ears.
Rinse body time! Rinse all the soap off — check your arms and legs for any bubbles left.
Free play and soak time! Now you've got a few minutes to just play.
Drain and final rinse time! Pull out the stopper and do one last rinse
Time to hop out and dry off.
Time to get dressed! Undies first, then pajamas — top, then bottoms.
